title: 第六章 齐心 · 下
content_zh:
齐威走后晚媚脱衣斜躺上床，虽然有些燥热，可最终还是睡着了，还做了个悠长的美梦。
当然她就是碧桃，看来胸大无脑的碧桃，这出戏到目前为止很成功，她需要养足精神来最后收网。
齐心回来之后坐到她床边，关上房门看她侧脸，一直呆坐到黄昏。
齐威公事繁忙，一般酉时上下回转，晚媚见时候差不多了睁开双眼，抱住被子一直缩到床角
没事。齐心柔声，安慰听来这般无力：你不会死的，我已经找到法子救你。
晚媚于是凑近了些：可是谁来救你呢少爷，如果老爷发怒，会不会连你也杀了。
不会。齐心抿了下嘴唇，心猛的漏跳了几拍：他不会杀我，只会不过我对将军是一心一意，他说过不会再有第二次，绝对不会再有。
话说到最后已经语无伦次，晚媚眯眼，在心底悄无声息的笑了。
回府之后齐威第一件事就是找齐心，不由分说一脚踹开了大门。
晚媚见状又往床角缩了缩，被褥遮不住春光，半露出一只雪白的乳房。
齐威顿时大怒，踢翻凳子看牢齐心，目光中盛满悲哀失落。
我说过不要碰她。他低声，怒火却在四处流窜：你是不是如今不再听我的话，我如果要你杀了这个女人，你也不会听！
齐心无辜睁圆了眼：可是我的确没有碰她，我
够了！齐威挥手目光如炙：她今早喝了整整一瓶春药，你若没碰她，她会舒舒服服躺在这里？你的谎话我不想再听，我只要你杀了她，你也只要干干脆脆回答我，愿还是不愿。
齐心闻言沉默，在原地踟躇了良久，最终还是从腰间抽出一把薄刀来，刃光雪亮对准了晚媚。
晚媚团了身子节节后退，可最终还是被他一把揭开被褥，将刀笔直送入了胸膛。
鲜血如花开般渗了开来，那把刀透胸穿背而过，看来晚媚是必死无疑。
这结果倒是出乎齐威意料，他在原地怔怔，觉得满腔怒火突然没了去向，一时间有些眩晕，连忙摸到桌边坐下。
那么我们再来谈谈先前的事。过一会齐威拿手指敲头：你为什么把那块墨玉送人，又为什么对我阳奉阴违，偏要和这个女人上床，将我的话当耳旁风。
齐心怔忡，这下更是不知所谓，不过想想还是上前，倒了杯茶递到齐威手间。

桌上那壶茶名叫冷香，一向是专为齐威预备的，齐威将茶端在手间，冷哼了声：这茶不会有毒吧。接着手腕下翻将茶泼了满地。
本来只是句无心的玩笑，可那杯冷香落地，居然呲一声冒出烟来，接着夸张的涌起了白沫。
父子二人于是无话了，齐心是无处辩解，而齐威则是心寒如铁。
满室于是只余沉默，可怕的沉默，撕裂一切割断一切的沉默。
最终还是齐威开了口，刹那间苍老十岁的声音满室回荡：这么说你是真的要背叛我，不是为了这个女人，是为了你自己。
那么你可记得你发过的誓，记得背叛我的下场！接下来的这句则是气贯云霄，将齐心那个不字生生淹没。
牵我的踏雪来！最终齐心听到了这句审判，一时间只觉天地合拢向他压来。
踏雪，便是齐威当年的坐骑，惹事后居然不曾被杀死。
齐威说过，这匹马让他不能人道，可齐心如果背叛他，结局则会比他更凄惨百倍。
马儿很快被牵来，齐威上前拴住房门，抬手喂了它一颗春药。
这情形齐心不是第一次见到，当年他私放一个侍女离府，齐威就曾恫吓过他，踏雪那骇人的性器就抵在他菊口外，虽不曾成真，可却让他惊魂至今。
恶梦很快再次上演，齐威又一次上来扯住他头发，将他狠狠顶上南墙，一把扯落了他小裤。
如被梦魇催引，齐心的手搭上了腰间，摸上刀鞘之内第二把刀柄。
昨晚一切历历在目，他被那枚长剑穿心而过，可昏厥片刻之后居然醒来，能走能动完全无恙。
那剑客说他本来是个杀手，也体会过被逼杀人的无奈，方才刺他那一下离心房半寸，看着凶险无比，可其实却是个空穴，最多让人昏厥半刻。
他问他要不要学，他当然是不能拒绝，于是一夜苦练之后那人还送了他一把佩刀。
这把是双刀合鞘，刀锋极薄，刺入空穴后更加无碍。留下这句话后那人就扬洒而去。
如今这把佩刀还在他腰间，双刀已用其一，还剩下一把。
心里第一个闪念是将它送入齐威空穴，这样既不害他性命，又能解了眼下这难。
可以后呢，这一难以后呢，就算误会澄清，齐威仍会对他心存猜忌，他还是会不得善终。

不如去死，一起去死。这念头最终轰鸣而来，裹挟了旧日所有委屈不平，顷刻间已是不可抵挡。
他听见踏雪嘶鸣，知道它已经抬起前脚，知道已经是时候痛下决心。
刀于是被拔了出来，他记得齐威和自己同高，于是反手一记将它送入了齐威胸膛。
刀没胸半寸，其实并不致命，齐威震怒，反掌劈上他后背，将他脊骨生生劈断。
齐心应声倒地，血沫从口鼻渗了出来，枯蝶似的睫毛轻轻扇动，神情是一派安详。
那一刻齐威失了魂，掩住伤口听踏雪受惊狂啸，这才明白自己失去了什么。
失魂的刹那他先伸手，一掌击毙了踏雪，接着定定完下腰去，想探齐心鼻息，完全没意识到身后晚媚已经起身，手里握着那把薄刀，正眯了眼步步向他靠近。
※※※※
齐威于是死了，被割断颈脖一刀致命，晚媚
地上齐心却还不曾死，正动也不能动看着这一切，看到最后居然有了笑意。
晚媚于是上前看住他：可怜你叫齐心，还信誓旦旦一定不会背叛你养父，到头来他还不是因你而死。
齐心眨了眨眼，那个笑意更大了：其实这样也好，他本不该这样活着。龙虎将军齐威，本该磊落光明。
谢谢你让我想明白这个道理。他抬起睫毛幽幽看住晚媚：我现下就陪他去死。姑娘心计深沉手段毒辣，但愿能有痴人和你真的齐心。
这最后一句他是带笑说的，可却是句再刻毒不过的怨咒，晚媚被击中痛处，急怒之下挥手，一刀割断了他咽喉。
鲜血漫地而开，地涌金莲伸出长蕊，任务最终成功了。
可晚媚却不能快活。
齐心，在鬼门这种地方，可会真有痴人和她齐心。
答案不得而知。
回鬼门之后，晚媚要人在院里装了一个秋千，架子做的极高，她在上面荡着，渐渐高出了院墙去，夏风吹开她的群摆，不时露出裙底春光。
院外很快有人驻足，她吃吃发笑，迎风荡的更欢，在最高处撒手丢开了绳索，人如纸鸢坠地。

秋千架下立时杀出条人影来，小三在地面仰头，接住她后又连打了几个滚，这才卸去了下坠之力。
夏日芳草清香，两人安全之后晚媚抱紧了小三腰身，看着他脸色煞白，又吃吃笑了起来。
我们一起荡秋千吧。笑到最后她牵起小三的手来：那种感觉真好，跟飞一样。
小三于是冷着脸跟她上了秋千，晚媚将裙裾抖开，盘腿坐在他胯上，足尖点地呼一声荡了开去。
那种感觉真是象飞一样，长风呼啸而来吹起晚媚头发，晚媚张开双臂，觉得真象长出了翅膀。
你对我是不是真心。就着风她在小三脸颊旁耳语，又一下咬住了他耳垂。
小三搂着她腰怕她摔下去，也拿她没办法，只好由她去咬，咬完耳垂咬脖子，咬到最后男根有了感觉，又被她一把掏将出来放进身体。
两人于是便在半空寻欢，夜色渐深有流荧飞过，晚媚伸手，抓住一只拢在了掌心。
你对我是不是真心。在小三膝上她又问了句，身子不忘起伏：说吧，在这里说鬼眼必然听不见。
反正我不会负你。这次小三有了回应，声音低而坚定。
晚媚眯眼飞走。
流荧得了自由扑闪翅膀，最后竟真的不曾飞走，悠悠落脚在晚媚胸前，随她呼吸明灭。
两人于是面面相觑，到最后晚媚垂头，靠上了小三肩膀。
那么我们齐心吧，齐心断金，你报仇我争取自由，最后一起飞走。说完这句之后她又直起身来，放浪欢呼在小三膝上扭动，象一条贪欢的水蛇。
你放心我不会负你。小三紧跟着又加了句，胯上挺最终达到高潮，满眼都亮起了星光。
晚媚快极欢呼，又一下用力将秋千荡向高处，高到飞出了院墙，好像真能带他们振翅飞去。
妹子还真是好兴致呢。两人正玩得痛快是底下有了人声，是娇媚的晚香，仰头看他们还拍起了巴掌。
秋千于是落了地，小三下来后躬身，很快就没了踪影。
晚香还是亲密的挽起了晚媚的手，笑面如花道：不知道妹子听说没有，虹影姐姐死了，天杀如今缺了个人呢，要从咱们地杀里面选一个替补。
晚媚也跟着笑出了花：那么恭喜姐姐了，姐姐是最有这个实力的。

妹子未必就没有这个实力啊。晚香停下脚步来看她，模样还是天真娇憨：虽说妹子入行不足一年，可公子说了，他替妹子破这个例，让妹子也参加竞选。

After Qi Wei left, Wan Mei took off her clothes and lay down on the bed. Although it was a little hot, she finally fell asleep and had a long and sweet dream.
Of course she is Bitao. It seems that Bitao has big breasts and no brains. This drama has been very successful so far. She needs to have enough energy to finally close the net.
After Qi Xin came back, he sat beside her bed, closed the door and looked at her profile, and sat there until dusk.
Qi Wei was busy with official duties and usually walked up and down during the hour. When Wan Mei saw that it was almost time, she opened her eyes, hugged the quilt and shrank to the corner of the bed.
It's okay. They spoke softly and comforted each other so weakly: You will not die, I have found a way to save you.
Wan Mei then moved closer: "But who will save you? Master, if the master gets angry, will he also kill you?"
Won't. Qi Xin pursed her lower lips, and her heart skipped a few beats: He won't kill me, he will only kill me because I am wholeheartedly devoted to the general. He said that there will never be a second time, and there will never be a second time.
The words were incoherent at the end. Wan Mei narrowed her eyes and smiled quietly in her heart.
The first thing Qi Wei did after returning home was to find Qi Xin, and he kicked the door open without any explanation.
Seeing this, Wan Mei shrank back to the corner of the bed. The quilt couldn't block the spring light, and one of her snow-white breasts was half exposed.
Qi Wei suddenly became furious, kicked over his stool and looked at Qi Xin, his eyes full of sadness and loss.
I said don't touch her. He whispered, but his anger was flowing everywhere: Are you no longer listening to me now? If I ask you to kill this woman, you won't listen!
Qi Xin innocently opened her eyes: But I did not touch her.
Enough! Qi Wei waved his hand and looked at her like hot sun: She drank a whole bottle of aphrodisiac this morning. If you hadn't touched her, would she be lying here comfortably? I don't want to hear your lies anymore. I just want you to kill her, and you just need to simply answer me whether you are willing or not.
Qi Xin was silent after hearing this, and hesitated in place for a long time. Finally, he took out a thin knife from his waist and pointed it at Wan Mei with a bright blade.
Wan Mei curled up and backed away, but in the end he lifted off the quilt and thrust the knife straight into her chest.
The blood seeped out like a flower, and the knife penetrated her chest and back. It seemed that Wan Mei was bound to die.
This result was beyond Qi Wei's expectation. He was stunned on the spot, feeling that the anger in his heart suddenly disappeared. He felt dizzy for a moment and quickly went to the table and sat down.
So let's talk about what happened before. After a while, Qi Wei tapped his head with his fingers: Why did you give away that piece of black jade, and why did you insist on sleeping with this woman and turning a deaf ear to my words?
Qi Xin was stunned, and now he didn't know what to say, but after thinking about it, he stepped forward, poured a cup of tea and handed it to Qi Wei's hand.
The pot of tea on the table is called Lengxiang, and it has always been specially prepared for Qi Wei. Qi Wei held the tea in his hand and snorted: This tea can't be poisonous. Then he turned his wrist down and poured the tea all over the floor.
It was originally just an unintentional joke, but when the glass of cold incense fell to the ground, it actually emitted smoke and then foamed up in an exaggerated manner.
The father and son were speechless. Qi Xin had no excuse, while Qi Wei was as cold as iron.
The room was filled with only silence, a terrible silence, a silence that tore everything apart.
Finally Qi Wei spoke, and in an instant the ten-year-old voice echoed throughout the room: So you really want to betray me, not for this woman, but for yourself.
Then remember the oath you swore and the consequences of betraying me! The next sentence was so powerful that it filled the sky, drowning Qi Xin's wordless words.
Bring me Tuxue! Finally Qi Xin heard this sentence of judgment, and for a moment he felt that the world was closing in on him.
Tuxue was Qi Wei's mount back then, and he was not killed after causing trouble.
Qi Wei said that this horse made him inhumane, but if Qi Xin betrayed him, the ending would be a hundred times more miserable than his.
The horse was quickly brought in. Qi Wei stepped forward to fasten the door, raised his hand and fed it an aphrodisiac.
This situation is consistentThis was not the first time he had seen her. When he let a maid leave the house privately, Qi Wei had threatened him, and Texue's terrifying penis was pressed against his anus. Although it never came true, it still frightened him to this day.
The nightmare soon happened again. Qi Wei came up and grabbed his hair again, pushed him against the south wall, and pulled off his pants.
As if prompted by a nightmare, Qi Xin put his hand on his waist and touched the second handle of the knife in the scabbard.
Everything was vivid in his mind last night. He was pierced through the heart by the sword, but he woke up after a moment of fainting and was able to walk and move completely fine.
The swordsman said that he was originally a killer and had experienced the helplessness of being forced to kill. The stab he just made was half an inch away from his heart. It looked extremely dangerous, but in fact it was just a hole. It could make people faint for at least half a moment.
He asked him if he wanted to learn, and of course he couldn't refuse, so after practicing hard all night, the man gave him a saber.
This is a double sheathed sword with an extremely thin blade, making it even more harmless after being pierced into a hole. After leaving these words, the man walked away.
The sword is still on his waist now, one of the two swords has been used, and there is still one left.
The first thought in my mind was to send it into Qi Wei's hole, which would not harm his life but also solve the current difficulty.
It can be solved, but it is difficult to solve this problem. Even if the misunderstanding is clarified, Qi Wei will still be suspicious of him, and he will still not end well.
It's better to die and die together. This thought finally came with a roar, carrying all the grievances and injustices of the past, and it became irresistible in an instant.
He heard Taxue neighing, and knew that it had raised its front legs, and that it was time to make a painful decision.
The knife was pulled out. He remembered that Qi Wei was the same height as him, so he sent it into Qi Wei's chest with a backhand.
The knife missed his chest by half an inch, but it was actually not fatal. Qi Wei was furious and struck his back with his palm, breaking his spine.
Qi Xin fell to the ground in response, blood foam seeping out from his mouth and nose, his butterfly-like eyelashes fluttering slightly, his expression was peaceful.
At that moment, Qi Wei lost his soul. He covered his wounds and listened to Ta Xue's frightened screams, and then he realized what he had lost.
At the moment when he lost his soul, he first stretched out his hand and struck Ta Xue to death with one palm. Then he bent down and tried to catch his breath. He didn't realize that Wan Mei had already stood up behind him, holding the thin knife in his hand, and she was approaching him step by step with her eyes narrowed.
※※※※
Qi Wei then died, his neck was cut and fatally stabbed, Wan Mei
The people on the ground were united but not dead yet. They were unable to move and looked at all this. At the end, they actually smiled.
Wan Mei then stepped forward to look at him: "It's pitiful that your name is Qi Xin, but you still swore that you would never betray your adoptive father. In the end, he didn't die because of you."
Qi Xin blinked, and his smile became even bigger: In fact, this is fine, he shouldn't live like this. General Qi Wei, the dragon and tiger general, should be upright and upright.
Thank you for making me think about this. He raised his eyelashes and looked at Wan Mei quietly: I will accompany him to death now. The girl is scheming and vicious, I hope there is a fool who can really be of the same mind as you.
He said this last sentence with a smile, but it was a curse that couldn't be more cruel. Wan Mei was hit in a painful spot, and in anger, she waved her hand and cut his throat with a knife.
Blood spread all over the ground, and the golden lotus stretched out its long stamens. The mission was finally successful.
But Wan Mei cannot be happy.
Qi Xin, in a place like Ghost Gate, there would really be an idiot who would be Qi Xin with her.
The answer is unknown.
After returning to Ghost Gate, Wan Mei asked someone to install a swing in the courtyard. The frame was made extremely high, and she swung on it, gradually getting higher than the courtyard wall. The summer wind blew her skirt open, revealing the spring under her skirt from time to time.
Someone soon stopped outside the courtyard. She was laughing and swaying in the wind even more happily. She let go and threw away the rope at the highest point, and she fell to the ground like a paper kite.
A figure immediately appeared from under the swing frame. Xiaosan raised her head on the ground, caught her and rolled a few times, and then the force of her fall was relieved.
The summer grass was fragrant. After the two were safe, Wan Mei hugged the mistress tightly and looked atHe turned pale and chuckled again.
Let's swing together. At the end of her laugh, she took Xiaosan's hand and said: It felt so good, just like flying.
The mistress followed her on the swing with a cold face. Wan Mei spread her skirt, sat cross-legged on his crotch, and swung away with a whine on her tiptoes.
The feeling was really like flying. The wind roared and blew Wanmei's hair. Wanmei opened her arms and felt like she had grown wings.
Are you sincere to me? She whispered against the mistress's cheek and bit his earlobe.
The mistress held her waist to prevent her from falling, but there was nothing she could do, so she had to bite her. After biting her earlobe, she bit her neck. At the end of the bite, she felt the penis, and she took it out and put it into her body.
The two of them then had fun in the air. As the night deepened, a firefly flew by. Wan Mei stretched out her hand, grabbed one and held it in her palm.
Are you sincere to me? She asked again on the mistress's lap, her body not forgetting to rise and fall: "Tell me, the ghost eyes will definitely not be able to hear it here."
Anyway, I won't let you down. This time the mistress responded, her voice low and firm.
Wan Mei narrowed her eyes and flew away.
Liu Ying was able to flutter her wings freely, but in the end she never really flew away. She settled leisurely on Wan Mei's chest, flickering and extinguishing with her breathing.
The two of them looked at each other, and in the end Wan Mei lowered her head and leaned on the mistress's shoulder.
Then let's work together, break the metal together, you take revenge and I fight for freedom, and finally fly away together. After saying this, she straightened up again, cheering wildly and twisting on the mistress's lap, like a lustful water snake.
Don't worry, I won't let you down. The mistress added another sentence immediately, and her hips finally reached a climax, and her eyes were filled with stars.
Wan Mei cheered happily, and swung the swing high with all her strength, so high that it flew out of the courtyard wall, as if she could really take them flying.
The girl is really in a good mood. The two of them were having a good time when there was a voice from underneath, it was the charming Wan Xiang, who looked up and clapped their hands.
The swing fell to the ground, the mistress bowed down after coming down, and soon disappeared.
Wanxiang still held Wanmei's hand intimately, and said with a smile like a flower: "I don't know if you heard about it. Sister Hongying is dead. God, there is someone missing now. We have to choose a replacement from among our underground killers."
Wan Mei also laughed out loud: Congratulations to sister, she is the most capable.
Girls may not have this strength. Wanxiang stopped to look at her. She still looked innocent and charming: Although the girl had been in the industry for less than a year, the master said that he would make an exception for her and let her also participate in the election.
